class.name: ECSSerializer
class.brief_description: Handles binary persistence and networking snapshots for the ECS.
class.description: [ECSSerializer] provides methods to save and load the entire world state to disk, and to capture high-frequency snapshots for networked multiplayer.

method.name: save_world
method.description: Saves the current world state to a binary file.

method.name: load_world
method.description: Loads a world state from a binary file, replacing the current simulation.

method.name: capture_snapshot_binary
method.description: Returns a compact binary delta of the current simulation state.
